traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.description: The chull's carrying capacity is 1,500 lbs.

traits.name: Plodding Pace
traits.description: The chull can only use the Move action once per turn.

actions.name: Defense Curl
actions.description: The chull retracts their head and legs to defend themself until the start of their next turn. While retracted, the chull's deflect value increases to 6 and they can use the Brace action as if they were in cover. At the start of each of their turns, the chull can spend 1 focus to maintain this effect for an additional round.

strikes.name: Pincer
strikes.description: Attack +4, reach 10 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) keen damage.
